svg.title: 香港主要建成区静态底图
svg.desc: 港岛、九龙、维多利亚港及南部新界局部；不含完整离岛。 OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0; Detailed land shoreline derived from OpenStreetMap coastline; only map-frame edges close clipped mainland faces. Prepared offline, no live map services.
